programme.title: Une Affaire d'amour
programme.desc: Mauvais timing : Thomas débarque à l'improviste chez son ex-copine, Sarah Pohl, une journaliste en pleine enquête sur des sans-papiers.

programme.title: On sera 2!
programme.desc: Afin de survivre à la fièvre des mariages de l'été, les vieux amis célibataires Ben et Alice, décident de devenir l'accompagnant de l'autre à chaque fois que l'un d'entre eux sera invité.

programme.title: Hotel new hampshire
programme.desc: Durant l'été 1939, Win Berry et sa future épouse Mary achètent un ours brun et une moto à un garçon nommé Freud. Plusieurs années après, Win et Mary, parents de 5 enfants, décident de restaurer une vieille bâtisse pour y établir un hôtel, le « New-Hampshire ».

programme.title: La montagne du silence
programme.desc: Les deux amies Johanna et Marlies sont spécialisées dans la conception de campagnes de marketing au sein de l'Association autrichienne du tourisme. Lorsqu'on a demandé à Johanna de commercialiser une région montagneuse isolée de Styrie en tant que nouvelle "destination de plaisir", son enthousiasme était limité. La citadine invétérée ne peut rien faire avec les montagnes, les fermes et les cloches qui sonnent. Son amie et collègue Marlies, en revanche, aime les montagnes par-dessus tout et est donc en feu lorsqu'elle se voit attribuer le contrat pour le projet sur la recommandation de Johanna. Elle parvient même à convaincre l'alpiniste de renommée mondiale Ferdinand Plocher de participer à la campagne - et elle s'intéresse aussi personnellement à ce charmant homme de plein air. Tout semble être parfait : Johanna peut rester à Vienne pendant que les Marlies, pleines de vie, se baladent dans les montagnes pour faire des recherches. Jusqu'à ce que Johanna reçoive la nouvelle choquante de la mort de son ami. Stupéfaite et accablée par un profond sentiment de culpabilité, elle se rend en Styrie pour ramener le corps de Marlies à la maison. Elle y retrouve Ferdinand, qui avait flirté sans retenue avec elle lors de sa visite à Vienne, mais qui se retrouve soudain à l'écart. Comme Marlies auparavant, Johanna loue une chambre d'hôte sur l'Almhof au frère de Ferdinand, Jörg, un solitaire amer qui doit s'occuper seul de sa fille malade Veverl. Les querelles constantes entre les frères différents rendent Johanna méfiante. D'autres éléments indiquent également que l'accident d'escalade de Marlies s'est produit différemment de ce qui avait été annoncé. Bien qu'elle rencontre un mur de silence parmi les villageois, elle continue à faire des recherches inlassables. Et même si Ferdinand ne l'aide pas vraiment, les deux se rapprochent émotionnellement. Plus Johanna passe de temps avec l'alpiniste passionné, plus elle apprend à apprécier les montagnes majestueuses et impressionnantes. Elle commence alors à tomber amoureuse de l'homme qui semble le mieux connaître les véritables circonstances de la mort de son amie.

programme.title: Love & Radio Star
programme.desc: Savannah est engagée pour redorer l'image du quatrième animateur radio de New York. Mais lorsqu'elle se retrouve accidentellement à l'antenne avec lui, elle devient elle-même partie intégrante de la nouvelle image de l'émission et découvre si leurs différences à l'antenne ou l'amour auront le dernier mot.

C'est la catastrophe et l'enfer des nuits detruites, des seances insupportables de calins sans parler de la chanson du Kangourou, qui font decouvrir a Sony un monde qu'il ignorait totalement.

Tandis qu'à l'extérieur le monde s'effondre, à l'intérieur, le manque de provisions et l'isolement vont vite rendre la situation intenable. Contraints de s'aventurer dehors, ils vont affronter leur destin et découvrir le véritable sens de l'amitié et de la rédemption.

programme.title: Ma Mère Et Moi
programme.desc: Récemment veuve, Marnie Minervini n'en demeure pas moins une éternelle optimiste. Elle déménage à Hollywood pour se rapprocher de sa fille, et peu à peu, se fait à l'idée de sortir à nouveau avec des hommes.

programme.title: The Ugly Truth
programme.desc: Ambitieuse productrice de talk-show, Abby Richter se targue de pouvoir trouver instantanément une solution à n'importe quel problème. Le seul qu'elle n'a pas réussi à résoudre, c'est son célibat. Lorsque le taux d'audience de son émission faiblit, Abby est obligée d'engager un nouvel animateur soi-disant expert en relations humaines, Mike Chadway. Dans l'émission, celui-ci traite de ce qui plaît vraiment aux hommes. Le choc est rude entre la jeune femme et ce provocateur odieux et macho. Le pire, c'est qu'il fait grimper l'audience et devient incontournable...

programme.title: PANDEMIE : 13 HISTOIRES DE VIE
programme.desc: L'année 2020 entrera dans l'histoire comme l'année où un virus a arrêté la planète entière. Au cours des premiers mois, dans un contexte de quarantaine et d'incertitude croissante quant à l'avenir, le festival Fantaspoa a lancé un concours pour que les cinéastes du monde entier créent leurs histoires liées à la pandémie - chez eux, avec les ressources dont ils disposaient. Cette anthologie rassemble les 13 courts métrages les plus représentatifs et les plus créatifs produits, capturant ce moment dans le temps qui, si l'humanité a de la chance, ne se répétera jamais.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva S3E3
programme.desc: As Parker asks Kim to return to the firm and Stacy quizzes Fred about his family, Eli secretly asks Jane to keep after ZygoLife. When the judge agrees to proceed and then reverses her decision because of the statute of limitations, Jane appoints herself Eli's legal guardian to pursue the suit on his behalf. Needing proof that Molly's expectations for her son weren't met, Eli produces a letter she wrote while pregnant that articulates her feelings about the future. Meanwhile, Fred hires an actress to pose as his mom for a dinner with Stacy, but when the fake mom causes more problems than she solves, both he and Stacy agree to never see her again. Back in court, Jane presses Molly to tearfully reveal the truth about what she expected in a son, causing Eli to demand that she stop. Just as she is about to abandon the case, Jane stumbles upon a technicality that forces ZygoLife to settle while sparing Molly another traumatic day in court. Finally, stunned to find that Judge Hemmings has been assigned the strip club case, Grayson makes good on his promise to ask his permission to marry Vanessa. As Jane is celebrating her win for the Hallers, she regrets leaving a scathing message for Bill after discovering that he couldn't call because he accidentally left his phone at her apartment.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva S3E4
programme.desc: When she's robbed as she's picking up the wedding rings, Jane (Brooke Elliott) ends up defending the critically ill thief in court. As the wedding day approaches, Parker (Josh Stamburg) drafts Grayson (Jackson Hurst) to defend an old college classmate (guest star Howard Hesseman) who's been arrested for selling camel's milk.

programme.title: Drop Dead Diva S3E5
programme.desc: After speaking to Jefferson High School's Fashion Club about modeling careers, Stacy enlists Jane to help Nina and Julia, two students who were denied a couples ticket to their senor prom because they are gay. Though it comes during a testy performance review by Parker, Jane agrees to take the pro bono case. When she threatens to file a lawsuit, the principal agrees to raise the girls' concerns with the superintendant. Meanwhile, when bailiff Hank Sullivan is ditched by his mail-order bride, Teri refers him to Grayson. And as Grayson looks to sue the matchmaking service that assured Hank that his $12,000 membership fee was well spent, Jane discovers that her new boyfriend Bill Kendal is seeing other women. While struggling with her feelings about Bill, Jane throws herself into representing Nina and Julia. After Nina's dad insists that she stop the lawsuit, a favorable ruling by the judge prompts the school to cancel the prom. As the case begins attracting a lot of publicity, Jane is blindsided when Parker takes over, and when the judge schedules the trial for the following month, Jane protests that the delay will mean that the girls won't be able to attend their prom. Meanwhile, though Grayson is sure that mail-order bride Irina Nesterenko's courtroom apology has hurt Hank's case, Kim looks to persuade another jilted husband to testify. Because of Jane's tenacity, Principal Duffy agrees to allow the girls to attend the prom as a couple if they will drop their lawsuit. However, when Duffy won't admit other gay couples too, Nina and Julia refuse to accept the principal's offer – with the full support of Nina's dad. Finally, as Jane and Stacy decide to hold their own prom for the girls and their friends, Grayson discovers that Irina conspired with the other man she jilted to rip off Hank. As Kim looks to help Grayson get over being left at the altar, Jane uses the prom she is throwing to break up with Bill.

programme.title: Emma Grede On Why You Can't Be A People Pleaser And A Leader
programme.desc: Entrepreneur Emma Grede, co-founder of Good American, discusses why women need to talk openly about money and know their worth. She explains why ambition isn't a dirty word, why you can't be a people pleaser and a leader, and why getting comfortable with failure and self-doubt is essential. As a mother of four, Emma shares her thoughts on mum guilt and why it's important that children see their mothers chasing their goals.

programme.title: Lucas Jones Explores What We're All Searching For In Life
programme.desc: Poet and actor Lucas Jones joins Fearne Cotton to explore what we're all searching for in life—whether we call it God, the Universe, spirituality, or science. They bond over their inability to do small talk, preferring deeper conversations about big feelings, and both share their experiences of living with OCD. Lucas discusses how therapy, particularly CBT, has helped him, but questions whether the rise in therapy reflects a loss of real community.

programme.title: Bryony Gordon On How People Pleasing Fuelled My OCD
programme.desc: Author and mental health advocate Bryony Gordon explores how people pleasing has fuelled parts of her OCD, alcoholism, and eating disorders over the years. Fearne and Bryony discuss the 'fawn' trauma response - appeasing others to stay safe - and chat about body image and the insecurities that have consumed them. Bryony reckons feeling 'too much' and 'not enough' are two sides of the same coin, and offers advice on how to confidently take up space.

programme.title: Boy George on AI, Spirituality & Why Jealousy Is Pointless
programme.desc: Boy George joins Fearne to discuss ego, jealousy, fame, grief and the mindset shift that changed everything. From embracing the Three Principles to tapping every morning, he explains how learning to pause before reacting helped him let go of resentment and feel lighter than ever. He opens up about loving fame and why he'd do it differently if he could start again, AI, and why "hating someone is completely pointless".

programme.title: Philippa Perry On Why Everyone Has an Inner Critic
programme.desc: Psychotherapist and author Philippa Perry discusses why everyone has an inner critic and how to stop believing yours. Philippa explains why not feeling 'good enough' is often less about truth and more about habit. She shares how to tell the difference between a helpful critical inner voice and a self-sabotaging one, and why negative thought patterns keep us stuck.

programme.title: Sam Thompson On His Anxiety And Undiagnosed ADHD
programme.desc: Sam Thompson discusses how anxiety and undiagnosed ADHD have shaped his relationships and self-confidence. He shares his experience of panic attacks, including one on the first day of I'm A Celebrity, and talks about therapy, the patterns he kept repeating, and his three go-to people during crises. Sam and Fearne debate people-pleaser approaches to leaving parties and discuss behind-the-scenes stories from his content creation work. Sam also reveals why he was willing to pay to appear on I'm A Celebrity.

programme.title: Gary Stevenson Interview
programme.desc: Gary Stevenson, economist and ex-Citibank trader, returns to PoliticsJOE just days after Andy Burnham became Prime Minister. Stevenson explains why he expects Labour to dodge serious taxation of the ultra-wealthy, instead quietly shifting the burden onto the upper middle class through moves like equalising capital gains and income tax. He breaks down why cutting VAT on energy bills is a quick political win rather than a real fix, and why he believes every government that fails to tax extreme wealth eventually gets forced into austerity, creating fertile ground for Reform and Farage.

programme.title: Ne-Yo Rates British Food, Tea, & Slang
programme.desc: Ne-Yo takes on The British Test, from making the perfect British cup of tea to trying Scampi Fries for the first time. The R&B superstar is thrown headfirst into UK culture, talks about what it means to perform in the UK, reveals why he'd love to be the 'Black Ed Sheeran', discusses what it's like to work with Pitbull, admits his crush on Leona Lewis, gives his thoughts on UK style, and hilariously trolls Jake Paul along the way.

programme.title: The Wayans Brothers & Anna Faris Quizzed!
programme.desc: Shawn Wayans, Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris go head-to-head in the JOE Pub Quiz. The comedy legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their biggest films, iconic roles, and career moments from Scary Movie and White Chicks to The House Bunny, Norbit, Just Friends, The Dictator and more.

programme.title: Norman Finkelstein Interview
programme.desc: Norman Finkelstein, foremost scholar on the politics of Palestine and Israel, discusses the deepening crisis in free speech stemming from public opposition to Western complicity in the Gaza conflict. He breaks down a lifetime of work on the Israel-Palestine conflict, explains shifts in the American and global right, and details underlying antisemitism in society and how it is deepened by crackdowns on freedom of expression.

programme.title: The Movie Elimination Quiz
programme.desc: 10 people go head to head in a movie quiz to see who will be the last one standing. If they get one question wrong they have to sit. If they get a second question wrong they have to kneel. And if they get a third question wrong, they are eliminated. 10 contestants compete for one cash prize.

programme.title: Old People Try Bizarre Food
programme.desc: The Old People are back, this time taking on some of the internet's most bizarre celebrity food combinations. From viral TikTok trends to A-list guilty pleasures, they try and rate Dua Lipa's Pickle Diet Coke, Channing Tatum's Peanut Butter, Jelly & Cheetos Sandwich, and Beyoncé's Banana with Ketchup. Will these celebrity creations be surprisingly delicious or completely disgusting. Our Old People give their brutally honest verdicts.

programme.title: Tom Holland vs Zendaya vs Jacob
programme.desc: Tom Holland, Zendaya and Jacob Batalon go head-to-head in the ultimate Spider-Man pub quiz. These legends put their memories to the test in a rapid-fire quiz covering their Spider-Man films. Do they know their lines, know about the franchise and even know random stills from the films? With bragging rights on the line and the title of pub quiz champion up for grabs, things quickly descend into chaos, confusion and comedy.

programme.title: We Quiz FLO On Their Own Songs
programme.desc: FLO go head-to-head in the ultimate JOE Pub Quiz. The girls put their music knowledge to the test in a rapid-fire battle featuring rounds including Guess the Legendary Song from the First 5 Seconds, Do They Know Their Own Song Lyrics and a test of their general music knowledge. Along the way, FLO take on Zara Larsson's iconic Lush Life dance, chat Ariana Grande, Rihanna and more, and things get seriously competitive as they battle it out to become the one and only JOE Pub Quiz champion.

programme.title: Did Boomers Create An Economy That Fails Young People?
programme.desc: As Britain faces a lost generation of over a million young people not in education or employment, the author of a sobering report into the epidemic, Alan Milburn, speaks to Ava about what the government need to do to put an end to the crisis in opportunities for young people.

programme.title: Gerry Adams on Palestine, a United Ireland, and His Awakening
programme.desc: Gerry Adams, one of the most significant political figures of the last fifty years, speaks to PoliticsJOE about his political awakening, Palestine, a united Ireland, and the future of Irish politics. In a conversation days before Andy Burnham's coronation and days after the burning of nationalist effigies on bonfires across his hometown, Adams discusses the necessary next steps for Burnham's government, how to quell the rise of the far-right, and how to prepare for the end of the union with Britain. Topics include Irish unity, sectarianism, the far-right and racism on the streets, loyalist paramilitaries, the Jeffrey Donaldson scandal, media bias, and his father's IRA past.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: The Impossible Football Geography Quiz

programme.title: Generational
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Generational, a series bringing together football fans from every generation to debate the biggest talking points in the game. Topics include whether the Premier League has ruined football, if players from the 60s and 70s could cope in today's game, whether Jack Grealish is better than Pelé, if the FA Cup is still a major trophy, and whether Manchester City should be stripped of their trophies if found guilty. Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: I Dream of Jeannie S2E31
programme.desc: Jeannie wants to celebrate the first anniversary of meeting Tony on the desert island where they met. Preparing for a space flight, Tony forgets the date. Annoyed, Jeannie makes his capsule land on the island where Tony finds a bottle.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E7
programme.desc: After telling Tony that he and Roger Healey have been tapped for a historic two-man space probe, scheduled to blast off the following week, Dr. Bellows asks him to report for a final check-up. When Tony asks Jeannie to return to her home, Jeannie asserts that since Tony freed her from the bottle, she belongs to him. She adds that she can give him a space capsule of his own. Tony tells Jeannie if he fails tomorrow's test, he will not go on the flight.Worried about Tony's safety, Jeannie causes him to blurt out the wrong answers to every test. Tony leaves Dr. Bellows, certain he has passed, but Jeannie tells him he has failed. Impressed by Tony's unhappiness, Jeannie goes to Dr. Bellows' office, where he is typing a report on Tony's unfortunate condition. Resorting to all her magic, Jeannie makes Bellows believe that he is not only losing his mind, but is near death. Tony is reassigned to the two-man flight. There, in outer space, Jeannie joins Tony as he floats from a tether attached to the capsule.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E8
programme.desc: Feeling that Jeannie must widen her horizons, Tony gives her a book "How To Be A Woman." Following the book's advice, to share her work with her man, Jeannie neglects her chores and allows the house to go to pot. Reading the chapter on clothing the successful woman, Jeannie charges an expensive wardrobe, in-cluding a mink coat. Convinced by the book that a man should take the woman out to dinner, Jeannie steers Tony to expensive Cafe Scheherazade. She starts a row when she criticizes the authen-ticity of the Arabian dancing.Literally taking the author's advice, Jeannie becomes a career girl and performs miraculous feats of instantaneous cooking while demonstrating electric stoves. Her employer, Sam, feeling she has been planted to get him into trouble with the Better Business Bureau, fires her. Later, after Tony feels he has straightened out things at home, Jeannie hears a news report about the flight of a Russian female astronaut. Blinking her eyes, she is outfitted as an astronaut and insists on accompanying Tony into space.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E9
programme.desc: Tony is assigned as technical director on a new astronaut movie being filmed in Hollywood. Jealous of the star, Rita Mitchell, Jeannie smuggles herself along. All of Jeannie's ruses, including a rainstorm, fail to keep Tony from getting close to Rita. Tony tells Jeannie he is lunching with Rita and jokingly tells Jeannie he would lunch with her instead if she were a star. Determined to become a movie celebrity, Jeannie, seeing a picture of Pola Negri, patterns her personality on the old-time vamp.Although her first try at getting into the movies is viewed as a gag, Jeannie manages to get a screen test with Jason Huberts, which arouses Tony's jealousy. When the test with Jason and Jeannie is shown, only Jason is visible and Jeannie suddenly realizes that genies do not register on film. She is consoled when Tony breaks a date with Rita and they register their footprints in front of Grauman's Chinese with all the movie greats.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E10
programme.desc: Jeannie gets involved with the law when, invisible to everyone, she attempts to drive Tony's car. Angered, Tony orders her to leave. Jeannie is aware that Tony has been studying the desalinization of seawater. Playing for time, she tells Tony her great-grandfather solved the problem. Tony asks to meet her great grandfather and Jeannie goes to get him. Tony phones Leslie Staples at the Department of Agriculture and tells him he is on the verge of converting salt water to fresh. Jeannie returns with her great grandfather, Bilejik, who proves that he can produce fresh water from salt water.When Tony returns to find Bilejik, Jeannie and a policeman are in front of his house. Bilejik has been causing all sorts of trouble with the neighbors. While resolving the matter, Tony discovers that Bilejik used seeds as a filter. After Bilejik leaves, Tony jubilantly reports to Staples. Staples tells him that these seeds are from a plant extinct for almost two thousand years.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E18
programme.desc: After arranging to meet Samantha to celebrate their six month anniversary, Darrin arrives at his office to meet Margaret Marshall, chairman of the board of a cosmetics firm. Margaret, a stunning woman in her late thirties, successful both with men and in business, insists that Darrin fly to Chicago that night to complete the quarter million dollar campaign he had planned for her company. Fumbling out of the anniversary arrangements with Samantha, Darrin flies to Chicago and meets Margaret, who has become quite interested in him, aboard her yacht. There, Darrin sees a cat and feels it may be Samantha, egged on by her mother, Endora, to fly to Chicago to check on his activities. While Darrin evades Margaret's advances, a pelican arrives on the scene. Although both Margaret and Captain Kelly feel there is something strange in Darrin's reactions to the animals, Margaret, realizing Darrin is truly in love with his wife, ac-cepts his advertising campaign. Greeted by Samantha at home, Darrin is reassured that the cat he has brought with him is not his wife. However, when the pelican arrives, Darrin is uncertain whether it might not be Endora.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E19
programme.desc: After Endora promises to curb her witchery for the even-ing, Samantha arranges a dinner for Darrin's parents and her mother to meet. Darrin is fearful of the results. Father Stephens has just retired and feels lost and insecure. Endora, being utterly charming, as she has promised Samantha, plays up to Father. Father once more feels life is worth living, but Mother Stephens becomes jealous. Before Mother is through, she is sure Endora wants to take Father from her. She asks Darrin for the name of a divorce lawyer. Darrin and Samantha work feverishly to save the marriage. Despite their efforts, Mother takes a train to Arizona and Father boards a plane on the first step of a world trip. Samantha asks Endora's help. Using her witchcraft, Endora brings both plane and train to Angel Falls, where Father had proposed to Mother years before. In the romantic setting, both realize they are much younger than they thought.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E20
programme.desc: When Darrin refuses to allow Samantha to act as matron of honor at cousin's wedding in Egypt, Endora tells him he's in trouble. Immediately Darrin starts having problems with his campaign to get the Woolfe Brothers Department Store account. despite Darrin's protests, Larry Tate gives him an assistant. The assistant, young Gideon Whitsett, soon maneuvers himself into being regarded as a brilliant young man. On the make, Gideon soon has Woolfe looking to him for ideas, which he has stolen from Darrin. Darrin is sure that Gideon is a warlock whom Endora has assigned to take his job. When everything else fails, Samantha decides to stop Gideon herself. Using witchcraft, Samantha gets Gideon to reveal the ruthless maneuvers he has been using to get Darrin's job. Darrin, who overhears the conversation, finally realizes Gideon is not a warlock. A right to the jaw puts Gideon out of action. His confidence restored, Darrin sells Mr. Woolfe on his idea for a successful campaign.

programme.title: Bewitched (Colorized) S1E21
programme.desc: Darrin's agency is unable to find a model for the "Jewel of the East" campaign. Darrin hopes they'll be able to do so, if only to bolster the confidence of Wally Ames, who is sub-stituting for the company's top photographer. Samantha trans-forms the Stephens' cat into a beautiful Oriental girl named Ling Ling. Everyone flips over her and the campaign is wrapped up. Darrin invites Larry and Louise Tate and Wally to a victory celebration at his home. Wally, intrigued by Ling Ling's feline grace, brings her along. Samantha's efforts to make Ling Ling give up Wally fail. To avoid a catastrophe, Samantha is forced to tell Darrin and asks him to warn Wally off, but Wally only becomes angry with Darrin. Samantha spikes Ling Ling's drink with truth serum. Wally bows out when Ling Ling displays her true cat nature. Later, Gladys Kravitz calls her husband when she sees Ling Ling clad in a mink coat, lapping milk from a saucer. By the time Abner gets to the window, Samantha has returned Ling Ling to her original state, and Abner gives his wife a spoonful of her nerve medicine.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.7
programme.desc: "Seoyeong visits her mother's hometown to bury her ashes and runs into Ujae who secretly followed her. Meanwhile Hojeong continues to do what she can to try and get Sangu's attention whilst Seoyeong's dad runs into trouble again and his daughter finally confronts him about why she hates him. In the end Ujae's mother discovers the photos that Ujae took of Seoyeong and the family go into an interrogation about Seoyeong's background. The heartbreaking and ardent love of Lee Sam-jae, Seo-young's father, for his daughter is depicted in this weekend drama, highlighting the preciousness of parental love. It teaches us that family is interconnected not only by blood but also by love."

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.8
programme.desc: Samjae continues to work hard as a hall manager to save money and face but ends up at the police station much to Seoyeong's disappointment. programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.9
programme.desc: Ujae's mother goes on a hunger strike to try and prevent Ujae's marriage but in the end she strikes a deal that forces Seoyeong to back away. In the end he decides that he can't do anything for her and leaves for the U.S. Meanwhile Hojeong tried desperately to meet Sangu one last time to return his handkerchief only to discover that his father's sick. She ends up nursing him and gets to see Sangu who confirms that he doesn't like her but doesn't hate her either. This is good enough for her.

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.10
programme.desc: Seoyeong is determined to maintain her lie about going overseas. There is no way she can confess to Ujae that she lied about her father. Sangu is distraught at her decision but can't help her out. There is no way that he can disown his father no matter how much he has hated him too. In the midst of this Hojeong agrees to go to the U.S. with the promise that after she returns she can do whatever she wants. In the end Samjae goes to be a pretend guest at a VIP's wedding... The twist is shocking!

programme.title: Seoyeong, My Daughter Ep.11
programme.desc: It's been 3 years since the last episode... Jiseon has a hard time adjusting to her perfect daughter-in-law... What every other mother-in-law would be happy about, she finds a burden and complains to Gapsun. Meanwhile Hojeong returns from the U.S., bringing back a man with her that she's sure her mother will accept. Migyeong is now dating Sangu and considering marriage whilst Seoyeong has to handle a major case and continues to grow weary of being a judge. Samjae is the one who is truly doing well with himself, having paid of his debts and worked hard to become a decent father. Perhaps he hopes for the day he'll be reunited with his daughter.

programme.desc: Fuerteventura, the second largest of the Canary Islands, is located just 120 kilometres off the coast of West Africa. The climate is extremely dry and the struggle for water has always been a major setback. Then, around a century ago, returning US emigrants brought what were then modern wind turbine water pumps from the Aermotor Windmill Company with them to Fuerte-ventura. Today, the environmentally friendly and so-called “Chicago's”, experience a renaissance. Unfortu-nately, original spare parts in good condition are diffi-cult to come by. When Leocadio Araya Sanchez began planting countless cacti on a barren hillside a few years ago, people thought he was mad. His idea was to make a healthy juice drink from the prickly pears – with great success. But getting the fruit to release its pre-cious superfood juice is no simple task. On an almost daily basis, Marcos Tapia is magnetically attracted to one of the paradisiacal beaches of the island. The 44-year-old is Spanish champion and vice world champion in para-body board surfing. When he was 28. Marcos was involved in a serious motorbike accident and has been paraplegic ever since.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina

Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: Menorca

Menorca also has its own distinctive charm, with its secluded coves, mighty cliffs, beautiful gardens and ages old towns and villages. Its residents love the is-lands treasures and peculiarities. Forests make up al-most a third of Menorca, complemented by many lush green meadows. Next to tourism, agriculture is a major source of the island's income to the present day. On Menorca, there are several accumulations of enormous megalithic stones. From a global point of view, the up to five-metre-tall "Taulas", whereby the stones are ar-ranged in the shape of a "T", are unique.

programme.title: Between Denmark and Latvia
programme.desc: The Baltic Sea is the youngest on earth and didn't evolve until after the last Ice Age. It seems so familiar, yet offers many surprises. The shores of the Baltic Sea are still shaped by wind and waves. The first episode takes us from Denmark's northernmost corner, via the Darss Peninsula in Germany and Lithuania's Curonian Spit to the endless beaches of Latvia. The film begins at the gateway to the Baltic Sea at Denmark's northernmost point: Skagen. It is here that the North Sea and the Baltic Sea meet and form a divide made of sand between Skagerrak and Kattegat. In June, hundreds of seals gather together on the lonely island of Anholt between Denmark and Sweden. It is the largest seal colony in the Baltic Sea. No camera team has ever been able to get so close to the animals as nature filmmaker Christoph Hauschild. Using remote-control cameras, he and his team have been able to capture intimate images of the way the seals live over and beneath water. For the very first time they follow a mother with her young to swimming lessons and in doing so, capture very emotional moments of these timid creatures. Most of the freshwater from the North Sea to the Baltic Sea, flows through the Store Baelt. In this sound, the underwater world is characterised by many species of saltwater loving fish. In the waters around Sjaelland, the largest stocks of harbour porpoise in the Baltic Sea. In 2016, the labyrinth of islands, sounds and fjords attracted two dolphins. They spent several months in the fjords of Flensburg and Kiel. Astounding images: they show familiar to us from the Mediterranean, but not something we would necessarily expect from the Baltic Sea.

programme.desc: Majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, raging waterfalls, threatening fjords, mighty glaciers, endless lava fields – there is hardly another country in the world that offers as much impressive nature as Iceland, the remote island in the harsh North Sea. The nature in Iceland is immense! Here, the four elements of nature can be experienced as raw and as close-up as practically no other place on Earth. And nowhere on the northern hemisphere can the origin of life, can growth and decay be experienced as dramatically as here. Besides the impressive nature, we get to know the dramatic history of the Viking culture with its nature-influenced mythology and discuss the negative effects of excessive tourism.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The next two stages take place in Quebec. With eight events over two days, SCL Canada is a true ‘heavyweight'. The athletes compete in: Truck Pull, Deadlift with cars, Log Lift, and the Atlas Stones. The World's Strongest Viking Jean-Francois Caron from Canada is a favourite, as well as current SCL leader Matjaz Belsak (Slovenia) and promising underdog Jimmy Paquet (Canada).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Welcome to the second day in Quebec. The athletes are fighting hard to win this two-day event. The last points of this SCL stage can be won over four outstanding disciplines: Power Stairs, Dumbbell Press, Keg Toss, and finally, the legendary Farmer's Walk. Who will leave Canada with the yellow ‘Leader Shirt'?

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Stages 8 and 9 of the SCL are hosted in Vaasa, Finland, taking place over a spectacular two-day event. After 3 wins so far, Matjaz Belsak from Slovenia plans to extend his lead at the top of the table. Among the other 13 highly motivated strongmen, two SCL legends will make their comeback to the competition: Former World Champion of 2015, Krzysztof Radzikowski (Poland) and Dainis Zageris (Latvia).

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The fight for the Finnish trophy continues. In this unmissable SCL event, the strongmen battle for the win in the Carry and Drag, the Forward Hold, Deadlifting with Cars and the Loading Race. Belsak, Radzikowski and Zageris look good after the first day, but the others haven't given up yet.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 2
programme.desc: Realizing they must defend the Kingdom from Jestro's monsters, the Knights try to organize but are despondent when they discover their best advisor – Merlok the Magician – has sacrificed himself to save them. When Jestro awakens, he's been blasted miles and miles away from the King's Castle by Merlok's explosive spell. And, it seems, all the books he was trying to steal have been scattered, too. The Book of Monsters broke Jestro' fall and now he can use the book to attack the people who laughed at him. Meanwhile, the King and his newly-trained Knights pick through the rubble of Merlok's library. They'll have to figure something out, because Jestro and his newly made magic monsters attack King's Castle! Clay organizes the Knights to defend the kingdom, but they've never worked together before. It takes all their training, plus the help of an old friend…MERLOK! Only now he's MERLOK 2.0. Ava has been piecing together what happened and discovering that the “ghost in the machine” she's been chasing is really Merlok in digital form. Now, he can use his magic digitally and he downloads just the right weapons to the struggling Knights! They finally foil Jestro's attack with Merlok's help and officially become NEXO KNIGHTS!

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted
programme.desc: Cole joins Jay and Zane inside the Nindroid to solve a mysterious puzzle and also Kai enters Zane's mind and suggests the Ninja take a break from puzzle-solving to figure out which villain is trying to hack their friend.

programme.title: The Jade Princess
programme.desc: In the wake of an assassination attempt targeting the royal family, the ninja invite the royal princess, HARUMI, into their makeshift family. Lloyd glimpses someone escaping over the rooftops with a sack on their back. Fearing it is the kidnapped princess, Lloyd takes up the chase! He discovers to his surprise, however, that the masked intruder is none other than the princess herself, who is not quite as docile or meek as she pretends. She has a habit of sneaking out of her chambers at night to feed the homeless who surround the Imperial Palace. This revelation only endears her to Lloyd more and Harumi and Lloyd quickly strike up a friendship. Unfortunately, trouble catches up to the ninja when the Sons Of Garmadon target the second Oni mask and attack the palace. The scope of the attack proves more than the Ninja were prepared for as the Sons of Garmadon detonate a series of subterranean bombs, bringing down part of the palace. Lloyd and Harumi escape onto the flying ship, DESTINY'S BOUNTY. But the victory is a pyrrhic one. The second Oni Mask has been stolen and Harumi's parents and Master Hutchins are feared lost.

programme.title: The Pranks
programme.desc: Stephanie finds the perfect front page story for the school paper! It's almost too good to be true. Emma and Andrea go undercover to solve the mystery of the two Jacobs.The friends are using their talents to pull a prank on Olivia. But who gets the last laugh?

programme.title: Girls on Mission
programme.desc: Things are getting mixed up on Andrea's first day on the job at Heartlake City Juicebar.Stephanie has to face her fears when the class gets an 'Animal Kingdom & 'school assignment.'Andrea relaxes at the beach while Emma is hard at work at her lifeguard tower.Mia and Stephanie have to use a little horse power at the Sunshine Ranch.Emma and Stephanie accidentally rent a scary movie and suddenly there are beasts everywhere...Olivia tapes a science show, with a little help from Mia's lemonade stand - and special effects!

programme.title: The Hands Of Time
programme.desc: Master Wu mistakenly tries to single-handedly complete a battle he began decades ago against Acronix, one of the twin Hands of Time. But the arrival of the first Time Blade – a weapon with the power to speed up time – sends the Ninja to the Monastery just in time to rescue their master from certain doom.

programme.title: The Hatching
programme.desc: The Ninja learn more about the Krux and Acronix – the two fallen Elemental Masters known as the Hands of Time – and are sure that this threat has finally been eliminated. But with Wu out of action and suffering from the effects of the Time Punch, the Ninja discover a new enemy in their midst: The Vermillion Warriors. And the Ninjas have no idea who controls them...

programme.title: A Time Of Traitors
programme.desc: Kai's investigation of a Vermillion Warrior Helmet leads him to discover that Krux is alive and well in Ninjago, living under an assumed identity. Meanwhile, as the Vermillion Warriors go on a kidnapping spree, Lloyd struggles with his role as master-in-training and Nya does her best to reboot Zane, who was knocked off line in his first battle with the Vermillion.

programme.title: The Mask Of Deception
programme.desc: When an unknown criminal syndicate threatens the Royal Family, the Ninja are called back into action and must protect the royal princess and a fabled artifact that may hold supernatural powers. The ninja find themselves scattered to the four corners of the kingdom. Cole and Jay are searching in vain for some sign of Master Wu. Nya fights injustice in the north, while Kai and Zane attempt to fend off an angry lava beast in the west. This leaves Lloyd alone in Ninjago City. He rushes to the scene of a heist at Borg Tower and finds himself up against a team of highly trained operatives led by the mysterious masked MISTER-E. Lloyd fails to prevent the heist and an ancient artifact, the MASK OF DECEPTION, is stolen. Lloyd apprehends one of the criminals but the others escape. Dismayed by his failure, Lloyd calls the ninjas back to Ninjago. The friends are reunited and hope for a little rest and relaxation. These hopes are dashed with the arrival MASTER HUTCHINS, a servant of the Royal Family of Ninjago, who has been sent by the EMPEROR to request their help. A new criminal gang, SONS OF GARMADON (SOG), is attempting to acquire three ancient masks called the ONI MASKS, which are rumored to possess supernatural powers.

programme.title: The Gray Knight
programme.desc: Using his Stone to Life magic the Cloud of Monstrox turns Clay into a living, fighting, breathing stone fighting knight. But will Clay use his forces to fight for good or for evil? Does he have a choice? The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro are able to unlock the forbidden Power Shocking Scare and unleash an attack on the village of Bravington. Knights in their new vehicles rush to the rescue and are able to defeat him with a new Combo Power. In the heat of the battle, the Cloud of Monstrox sees the stone statue of Clay and zaps him to life! Clay is now turned, and is fighting against his friends. It is impossible for them to defeat him without destroying him for good. The Cloud urges Clay on. He attacks the Fortrex in order to get to Merlok. Robin in his Black Knight Mech is trying to stop him, but to no avail. Merlok 2.0 is left undefended. At the very last moment Merlok 2.0 unleashes a blasting spell that sends Clay far far away.

programme.title: The Good, The Bad And The Tightwad
programme.desc: Clay wakes up in the poor town of Nothing Hill which literally have nothing. Will Clay remember who he is and what he is fighting for. His friends try to help him, but Jorah Tightwad and his Bots get in the way. Clay as the Gray Knight wakes up far away in a place called Nothing Hill. A poor town where they literally have nothing. They harvest dust. Jorah Tightwad though has found that there is gold underneath the town. He convinces the confused Clay to help him put pressure on the poor townsfolk to give up their lots. This is an easy job for the strong Gray Knight. The NEXO KNIGHTS finally track him down and tries to convince him about who he is. But to the Gray Knight they are still his enemies, and a giant battle ensues in order to subdue the Gray Knight. At last, only Macy is left. When she begins to recite the Knights Code, some words and their meaning are able to get through the stone hard shell of the Gray Knight and the Evil that clouded him seems to disappear. Together they are able to return the ownership of the town to the villagers.

programme.title: The Book Of Monsters, Part 1
programme.desc: When Jestro the Jester finds the Book of Monsters, chaos breaks loose in the Kingdom of Knighton. Can the newly graduated Knights from the Knights' Academy save the kingdom? It's final graduation fighting exams for the latest Knights from Knights' Academy. All our new Knights demonstrate their prowess: CLAY, AARON, AXL and LANCE. PRINCESS MACY get to join them, but her father doesn't want her to graduate. As part of the entertainment, MERLOK does an amazing magic trick. His act is followed by…JESTRO, the King's Jester. He's terrible (and he should know to never follow a better act.) Everyone laughed because he's a real joke....a total failure. While Jestro roams the halls fo the King's Castle, forlorn, he hears the BOOK OF MONSTERS calling to him from Merlok's library. The book talks Jestro into gathering as many books of spells as he can carry, but they're interrupted by...Clay! As Jestro quickly pages through the Book of Monsters to attack Clay, Merlok arrives. There's a battle in the library between Jestro and Merlok. Finally, the wizard summons up his most powerful spell in self-defence. BOOM! There's a big, magical explosion and when Clay forces his way back into the library, Merlok, Jestro and the magic books are...GONE!

Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. programme.title: Duniyadari
programme.desc: Europe is bracing for possible Russian cyberattacks, sabotage, or military escalation, with attention on the strategically vital Suwałki Gap. Meanwhile, Iran warns of renewed US strikes and the Houthis target Saudi interests, putting Washington in a complex position amid rising oil prices and upcoming midterms.

programme.title: Kharcha Paani
programme.desc: Tata Sons' board has backed N Chandrasekaran for another term, but Tata Trusts—led by Noel Tata—has questioned the validity of the decision, intensifying the battle inside India's biggest business group. The episode examines the power struggle, Tata Trusts' 66% ownership, and the succession question after Ratan Tata.

programme.title: Rajdhani
programme.desc: Asaduddin Owaisi has set October 2 as the deadline for an alliance ahead of the 2027 UP Assembly elections, but Akhilesh Yadav and other opposition leaders have not responded positively. The episode examines whether this is a bid for a broader alliance or a strategy to establish AIMIM as a separate force in UP.

programme.title: Sehat
programme.desc: In today's Sehat show, Dr. Sarika Pandya explains how dirty toilets increase UTI risk, Dr. P.N. Renjen discusses early signs of Alzheimer's in younger people, and dietitian Kavita compares moong dal chilla vs moong dal khichdi for digestion, weight loss and diabetes.

programme.title: UP Bulletin
programme.desc: Akhilesh Yadav dissolved the organisational and frontal units of the SP in Etah and Kasganj after a tense meeting between party leaders in Lucknow. He also rejected Asaduddin Owaisi's alliance proposal for the 2027 UP elections, saying the existing alliance would continue.

programme.title: The cinema Show
programme.desc: Aamir Khan is set to begin shooting for the '3 Idiots' sequel, while Shah Rukh Khan may team up with Mani Ratnam for a mature romantic drama after 'King'. Also in today's episode: Robert Pattinson's new look from 'The Batman: Part 2', Brad Pitt returning for the 'World War Z' sequel, and IIFA 2027 in Abu Dhabi.

programme.title: Zero Cricket Knowledge
programme.desc: After the Indian women's team again refused to collect the Asia Cup trophy from ACC president Mohsin Naqvi, the big question now is whether India will have to accept gold medals from him at the 2026 Asian Games. Reports suggest Naqvi could be delegated by the Olympic Council of Asia to present the medals.

programme.title: Aasan Bhasha Mein
programme.desc: Julian Assange has returned to X after years of silence with a simple post: "I'm back." This video traces his journey—seven years in the Ecuadorian embassy, five years in Belmarsh Prison, the 2024 US plea deal, and his quiet return to Australia.

programme.title: Tarikh
programme.desc: This episode of Tarikh explores three unforgettable 9/11 stories: Edna Cintron, the woman seen waving for help from the North Tower the mysterious man in Richard Drew's Falling Man photograph and Lauren Grandcolas, who left a final phone message for her husband aboard United Airlines Flight 93.

programme.title: Sciencekaari
programme.desc: The Himalayas face growing disaster risks—from melting glaciers and GLOFs to landslides, avalanches, and flash floods seen in Kedarnath 2013, Chamoli 2021, Sikkim 2023, and Dharali 2025. This Sciencekaari episode explores why glaciers are melting and how climate change triggers cascading disasters.

programme.title: Daily Video
programme.desc: In 2005, Qazi Touqeer saved Arijit Singh from elimination on Fame Gurukul, sparking a friendship that lasted decades. While Arijit became one of India's biggest music stars, Qazi faded from the spotlight—and is now back as a contestant on Bigg Boss 20.

programme.title: Daily Video
programme.desc: A minor boy and girl were allegedly stopped on a road in Bihar's Jamui and subjected to physical assault and sexual harassment, with two videos of the incident going viral. Police have arrested three accused—Mithilesh, Pramod and Golu—while Rahul Gandhi demanded strict action under POCSO and questioned the delay in arrests.

programme.title: Daily Video

programme.title: Ground Report

programme.title: Ground Report
programme.desc: The Lallantop spoke to Balaghat SP Aaditya Mishra about how policing is changing in the Naxal-affected region, focusing on the Ekal Suvidha Kendra model that brings government services closer to remote tribal villages.

programme.title: Ground Report

programme.title: LIVE GURBANI KIRTAN FROM AMRITSAR
programme.desc: Live Gurbani Kirtan from Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib on GTC Punjabi Television brings viewers a sacred spiritual experience directly from one of the most revered historical Gurudwaras of Sikhism, located in the heart of Delhi. This live telecast offers devotees the divine resonance of Gurbani Kirtan, performed by esteemed Ragis, filling homes with peace, devotion, and spiritual reflection. Gurudwara Sri Sis Ganj Sahib stands as a powerful symbol of supreme sacrifice and unwavering faith, marking the martyrdom of Sri Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji, who laid down his life for the protection of religious freedom and human rights. Through this live broadcast, GTC Punjabi Television connects Sangat across the globe to the serene atmosphere of the Gurudwara, allowing viewers to immerse themselves in Naam Simran, Shabad Kirtan, and the timeless wisdom of Gurbani. The soulful renditions inspire inner calm, strengthen spiritual connection, and spread the universal message of love, equality, and humility as taught by the Sikh Gurus.

programme.title: Gurmat Vichar
programme.desc: Katha by Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji on GTC Punjabi Television presents a profound spiritual discourse rooted in the timeless wisdom of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji. Renowned for his deep knowledge, powerful narration, and simple yet impactful explanations, Bhai Sahab Pinder Pal Ji brings Gurbani to life by connecting its teachings with everyday human experiences. Through soulful storytelling, historical references, and meaningful interpretations of Gurbani, this Katha guides the Sangat towards self-reflection, humility, and spiritual awakening. Each session offers clarity on life's challenges while emphasizing the values of Naam Simran, Seva, truthful living, and unwavering faith in Waheguru.

programme.title: Shabad Amrit
programme.desc: Shabad Amrit is a soulful devotional songs slot dedicated to the divine verses of Gurbani. The segment features a curated selection of sacred Shabads and spiritual hymns that inspire peace, reflection, and inner harmony. Designed to create a serene and uplifting atmosphere, Shabad Amrit offers viewers a moment of calm amidst daily life, connecting them with spirituality through melodious renditions and meaningful lyrics. Rooted in devotion and reverence, the slot serves as a spiritual pause—where music becomes prayer and faith finds its voice.

programme.title: Desi Beatz
programme.desc: From foot-tapping beats to soulful melodies, Desi Beatz showcases a dynamic mix of popular artists, fresh releases, and trending music videos that reflect the pulse of today's Punjabi youth. The show captures the essence of modern Punjab—where tradition meets contemporary sound—making it a perfect blend of rhythm, style, and desi swag. Designed for music lovers of all ages, Desi Beatz turns every moment into a celebration, whether it's party anthems, romantic hits, or viral sensations. Tune in to GTC Punjabi Television and stay connected with what's trending in Punjabi music—loud, lively, and full of desi energy.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.4
programme.desc: The Yoon Daehyeong faction schemes to place Bogyeong as the future queen of Gyotaejeon. Ahead of the royal selection of the Crown Princess, Hwon secretly expresses his wish for Yeonwoo to submit her maiden registration. Meanwhile, Princess Minhwa's feelings for Yeom deepen, and she stubbornly demands that the king grant her permission to marry him.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.5
programme.desc: Yeonwoo remains at the royal villa, Eunwol Pavilion, devoting herself to rigorous court etiquette training. Unable to withstand the Queen Dowager Yoon's threats, Nokyoung casts a forbidden spell on Yeonwoo. Cast out of the palace and sent back to her family, Yeonwoo's illness steadily worsens. In secret, Nokyoung approaches Yeonwoo's father with a dangerous proposal.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.6
programme.desc: Trapped in terror inside a coffin, Yeonwoo is ultimately rescued by Nokyoung and returned to the world—only to awaken with all her memories erased. Taking Yeonwoo's place, Bogyeong ascends as Crown Princess. As Crown Prince Hwon comes of age, the kingdom's political situation grows ever more precarious under the schemes of powerful in-law families.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.7
programme.desc: Nokyoung repeatedly warns Yeonwoo to be wary of strangers. Defying Seol's pleas, Yeonwoo ventures into the streets, drawn by her desire to glimpse the king's royal procession. Catching sight of Hwon from afar, Yeonwoo is thrown into deep confusion.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.8
programme.desc: To use Nokyoung's spirit daughter Wol as a human talisman, she is abducted. As Wol attempts to escape, she receives help from Yangmyung—yet fails to recognize him. Dragged into the palace, Wol is forced to enter Hwon's bedchamber as a shaman meant to absorb misfortune.

programme.title: Moon embracing the sun Ep.9
programme.desc: Upon awakening, Hwon fiercely interrogates Wol, demanding to know who sent her—yet finds himself strangely preoccupied with the shaman. Hearing of Wol's presence, Bogyeong instinctively senses an ominous threat closing in.

programme.title: Indipedia
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: Umeed India
programme.desc: If you'd imagine an ace cricketer to host a television show, you can be sure it will be a sports related series. And, Umeed India makes a compelling case. For the first time, versatile cricketer Virender Sehwag will host a television show. Umeed India will showcase groundbreaking stories of diversified, intrepid athletes aiming for glory at Olympics 2020. For the 13-part series, Virender reinstates the fact that Olympic stars never ‘just' appear at the Games. Their stories start in small villages, where they train every day – with one aim in mind – bringing home that Gold. Watch Virender travel to their training bases, chronicling exciting moments in the home environment besides interviewing the athletes' families and coaching staff. The episodes feature inspiring stories of OP Karhana, Suyash Yadav, Avtar Singh and Dutee Chand along with Sakshi Malik, Vinesh Poghat among many other Olympians. Can we find the 2020 medalists for India in 2017?

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Regiment Diaries
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Destruction Decoded
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: A Day In The Life Of Earth

programme.title: The new Porsche 911 GT3 R
programme.desc: The turbocharged three-litre flat-six in the new 911 GTS delivers 353 kW (480 PS). Maximum torque is 570 Nm, an increase of 20 Nm over its predecessor. Zero to 100 km/h takes just 3.3 seconds (911 Carrera 4 GTS: Fuel consumption combined (NEDC) 10.5 – 9.7 l/100 km, Fuel consumption combined (WLTP) 11.4 – 10.6 l/100 km, CO₂ emissions combined (NEDC) 240 – 222 g/km, CO₂ emissions combined (WLTP) 259 – 240 g/km) in the 911 Carrera 4 GTS Coupé with the eight-speed Porsche dual-clutch transmission (PDK): three tenths faster than its predecessor. A seven-speed manual transmission with a particularly short throw is available for all 911 GTS models as an alternative to the PDK.

programme.title: From concept vehicle to full-production ID. Buzz
programme.sub-title: How was the electric Microbus created
programme.desc: The new model line's assistance systems perfect ease of driving and safety. Included as standard in the ID. Buzz and ID. Buzz Cargo is the ‘Car2X' local warning system, which utilises signals from other vehicles and the transport infrastructure to spot hazards in real time. Also included as standard: the ‘Front Assist' emergency braking function and, in the MPV, the ‘Lane Assist' lane-keeping assistant. With new software, new assistance functions are also making their way into the ID. family. Available as an option is ‘Travel Assist with swarm data', which facilitates partially automated driving across the entire speed range and, for the first time, assisted lane-changing on the motorway. Also new: the ‘Memory Function' for automated parking on a previously saved route.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.desc: The sixth generation Opel/Vauxhall Astra and third generation Peugeot 308 are both based on the Stellantis EMP2 platform and, unsurprisingly, score very similarly across all four areas of assessment. Both the offset test and the full-width crash test highlighted marginal chest injury protection for average male and small female drivers, and neither car was equipped with a centre airbag for far-side crash protection, a countermeasure which is increasingly common on modern cars. Both cars offer plenty of crash avoidance technology but do not include some of the latest advancements introduced in the market. The cars' four-star ratings apply also to their PHEV variants.

programme.title: Volvo Cars and Epic Games bring real-time photorealistic visualisation
programme.desc: To offer its customers the best possible user experience, Volvo Cars is bringing photorealistic visualisation technology into its next generation of electric cars through a new collaboration with Epic Games. The companies are teaming up to bring Epic's Unreal Engine game engine into upcoming Volvo cars, providing unparalleled high-quality graphics inside the cabin. Epic Games is a leading interactive entertainment and software company probably best known for Fortnite, one of the world's largest games. Epic Games also develops Unreal Engine, widely considered to be the most advanced real-time 3D creation tool used in various industries beyond games, and which will now be used by Volvo Cars for developing digital interfaces inside its cars and rendering real-time graphics in the car.

programme.title: Pure Design

programme.title: Pure Design
programme.desc: New homeowners Juliette and John attempted to modernize their small kitchen but only managed to upgrade the counter and backsplash. Designer Samantha Pynn steps in to offer a practical eco-friendly solution - make the most of what they already have by using colour to integrate the existing elements. Then add a bit of texture to the walls, a cozy banquette, café tables and the result is a Scandinavian-inspired bistro - without having to start from scratch!
